classifications.rationale: The President presently imposes a binding quantitative limit on meat that may be entered or withdrawn for consumption in 1971; the legal restriction occurs through this proclamation itself.
The President makes the statutory determination and presently suspends the proclaimed import limitation for 1971, directly altering the otherwise applicable legal restriction.
classifications.evidence: The limitation proclaimed in paragraph (1) is suspended during the calendar year 1971

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination fixing the necessary duration of the suspension, completing the legal basis and period for that suspension rather than directing a later agency outcome.
classifications.evidence: It is hereby determined necessary that such suspension shall be for such period
